candidates.title: BJP Nominates 8 Leaders To Rajya Sabha From UP, Hardeep Puri Not On List
candidates.excerpt: The BJP has announced eight names for the coming Rajya Sabha election from Uttar Pradesh, keeping a balance between castes and ensuring election on at least one seat on October 16.

candidates.title: BRSV seeks cancellation of Nova Medical College recognition
candidates.excerpt: BRSV has demanded cancellation of Nova Medical College’s recognition, alleging inadequate infrastructure, faculty, laboratories and other facilities. State president Gellu Srinivas Yadav also alleged irregularities in granting permissions and questioned the approval of 250 MBBS seats

candidates.title: KTR demands withdrawal of coal mine proposal near Ramappa temple
candidates.excerpt: BRS working president KT Rama Rao opposed the proposed open-cast coal mine near Ramappa temple in Mulugu, warning that mining and blasting could threaten the UNESCO World Heritage Site and adjoining lake. He demanded withdrawal of the proposal and warned of agitation

candidates.title: After Hindu Outfit Protest, SRFTI Students Demand Security, Continue Boycott
candidates.excerpt: In a statement issued on Monday, SRFTI said it "remains deeply concerned about the incidents that occurred on Sunday (October 4) and reiterates its commitment to ensuring the safety, security and well-being of its students."

candidates.title: Ex-prince Andrew asks to ‘quash’ Epstein affair search warrants: U.K. judiciary
candidates.excerpt: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor has challenged Thames Valley Police over searches of his former and current homes on royal estates, ahead of a private High Court hearing

candidates.title: SC seeks EC response on changes during SIR: Why Form 6 has become a flashpoint
candidates.excerpt: A bench comprising Chief Justice Surya Kant and Justices Bagchi and Mohana sought responses from the Election Commission, the Centre, the CEC and the other two election commissioners before examining whether the poll panel's statutory procedure was followed. The bench refused to pass an immediate order seeking the suspension of CEC , while considering the controversy over Form 6, which was one of the central issues raised in the petitions.

candidates.title: 'India-US Trade Talks May Have Reached Plateau': Nirmala Sitharaman
candidates.excerpt: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman said the two countries could still explore whether there was any room for further negotiations.

candidates.title: 2021 injury row: Mamata's lawyer sends notice to hospitals over record 'disclosure'
candidates.excerpt: Mamata Banerjee's lawyer issued a legal notice to two hospitals over "unauthorised" medical record disclosures. This followed allegations made by West Bengal chief minister Suvendu Adhikari about her 2021 leg injury. Adhikari claimed that her injury was "faked" during the assembly elections, where she campaigned from a wheelchair. The notice sought clarification on how her medical records were revealed without permission.

candidates.title: Justice Bhuyan: ‘Mass voter exclusion would negate constitutional order’
candidates.excerpt: The Supreme Court judge says no amount of whataboutery can justify the exclusion of voters en masse from the electoral rolls as such an action is fatal to the Constitution.

candidates.title: ‘Wounds, bruises and black marks’: Family questions Indian sailor’s death after 5 months in pirate captivity | Exclusive
candidates.excerpt: Indian sailor Mohammed Tanweeruz Zaman was held captive for nearly five months after the MT Honour 25 was hijacked off Somalia. Reported killed during a rescue, his family questions the crossfire account, citing wounds and bruises, and alleges he may have been tortured.

candidates.title: SIR row: Supreme Court refuses to pass interim order on suspending CEC Gyanesh Kumar, issues notices to EC, Centre
candidates.excerpt: Plea in SC to suspend CEC Gyanesh Kumar: A Supreme Court bench headed by Chief Justice of India Surya Kant issued notice to the Election Commission of India, seeking its response on the allegations made in the plea.
